about.title: Engineering from the UI down to the socket

profile.name: Velan D
profile.summary: Software Developer & Full-Stack Freelancer building robust web applications, AI tools, low-level networking utilities and resilient backend systems.
bio: I am a software developer and independent freelancer with an unyielding curiosity for how things work under the hood — from high-level web applications down to low-level Linux socket communications.

Whether it's building interactive user experiences, architecting AI-powered tools like DreamCatcher and Resume-Matcher, or profiling network round-trip latencies in C++, I craft software that is not only functional, but clean, maintainable and reliable.
Beyond the editor, I'm a football enthusiast and admirer of Lionel Messi's playmaking — precision, composure under pressure and vision are the standards I bring to my engineering.

skills.description: Fast, accessible, responsive and delightful interfaces.
Dependable logic, networking layers and data flows.
Automation workflows, version control and intelligent integrations.

projects.title: Resume-Matcher & Analyzer
projects.summary: AI harness that parses resumes, scores them against job descriptions and generates tailored PDF resumes and cover letters with multi-LLM support.
projects.problem: Tailoring a resume for each job is slow and hard to measure objectively.
projects.solution: A modular Python pipeline that parses documents, scores skill/experience alignment and drives LLMs with reusable prompt templates.
impact: Multi-provider LLM support for local and cloud inference
Automated alignment scoring for skills and experience
Parses PDF, DOCX and Markdown resumes

projects.title: DreamCatcher
projects.summary: Interactive web app that captures dreams, performs semantic interpretation and surfaces recurring themes as actionable reflections.
projects.problem: Dream journals capture text but provide no insight into patterns.
projects.solution: A lightweight frontend with semantic parsing that extracts symbols and themes from each entry.
impact: Semantic extraction of archetypes and metaphors
Fast, dependency-light UI with dark mode

projects.title: Socket Ping
projects.summary: High-performance Linux network tool in C++ using raw POSIX sockets to measure round-trip time, jitter and transmission health.
projects.problem: Standard tools hide the details needed to diagnose latency and jitter precisely.
projects.solution: Raw POSIX sockets with microsecond timers and statistical analysis of every probe.
impact: Robust handling of timeouts and packet loss
Portable for embedded and server diagnostics

projects.title: Website & System Monitor
projects.summary: Python tool tracking response codes, latency and system health for early incident detection.
projects.problem: Outages are often noticed by users before the owner.
projects.solution: Configurable polling with threshold-based alerts, running as a lightweight background service.

projects.title: Linux Socket Library
projects.summary: Documented Linux socket implementations for client-server communication and multi-client connection management.
projects.problem: Socket programming references are often fragmented or outdated.
projects.solution: Clean encapsulation of the socket lifecycle with non-blocking and multiplexing examples.

projects.title: This Portfolio
projects.summary: React + Vite static site driven entirely by a JSON content file, with SEO metadata, command palette and automated GitHub Pages deployment.
projects.problem: Updating a portfolio usually means editing markup.
projects.solution: All content lives in one JSON file; a commit triggers a CI build and deploy.
impact: Content-driven: no code changes to update
